steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's past midnight, again... gotta finish my report on Kjeragandr...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I can't believe the day would come when I wrote the word 'Feranmut' in a report...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Oh, Director Muelsyse! What brings you here?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well if it isn't Elena! I knew you'd still be here this late.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You've spent an entire month cranking out reports since coming back to the station. You don't hafta push yourself so hard.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It took forever just to put the data together. Then there were experiments I had to replicate in the lab to—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Science will survive you taking a couple days off, girl.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Speaking of which, the station's scheduled break starts tomorrow.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I think you applied to stay in Kjerag?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I did...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Lemme guess—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: D-Don't look at me like that! I know, I know, I won't use it to put in extra time.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I hardly ever left the station before the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I did take a trip down the mountain after it happened, but as you know, it was... er... not exactly a sightseeing trip.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's one way to put it. Hehe...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That's why I wanted to take a good look around Kjerag during the break.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Now we're talkin'.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I just popped in to remind you that every researcher choosing to stay in Kjerag gets a local volunteer guide, to help you settle into the place.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Yours is coming first thing in the morning. So hurry up and get to bed, don't wanna oversleep.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Alright... after I'm done with this one! I only have a few hundred words left.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Fine, fine, have it your way.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Make the most of tomorrow, Elena, and don't forget to try the fondue.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Of course. I'm not missing it for anything this time!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's you—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: What? You don't recognize me?
The young huntress brushes the snow off herself, while the Rift Cloudbeast yelps excitedly at Elena from her left shoulder.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: (Whisper) It's okay, Rift Cloudbeast. Elena can be a bit dumb, but not dumb enough to forget us after just a few days.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Hey, I heard that!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Never mind. The Director said a local guide would be coming to help me acclimate. Don't tell me—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Yeah, I'm your guide.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: I was on my way to pick up my siblings when I saw the posters your people put up looking for volunteers, so I signed up.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: The lady who did the interview was really excited. She said I was as local as it gets.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Well, you certainly look the part...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Okay... should we go and find Enya?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: The Saintess can't go outside so easily. Besides, she must be busy with things at the Vine-Bead Court—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: You don't believe me?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No, I never said that...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Then we're good. Tell me where you want to go, and I'll take you there.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Let me think...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It'll almost be noon by the time we get down the mountain, and I haven't even had breakfast yet.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You got any recommendations for a good fondue place?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: A what place?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You've never heard of fondue?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Are you even from Kjerag?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: One of us is from Kjerag, and it's not you.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Of course I know fondue, but only city folk eat it. My roast meat and sausages at home are so much better.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But all the Columbian guidebooks list fondue as one of the top ten foods you have to try before you die!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Pfft, you Columbians know nothing about food. The best cuisine in Kjerag is wild game from the mountains.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What's your plan, then?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: We don't have enough time to hunt, and I don't have much in store to spare.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: But hunters who live on the mountains always save some game. We can join them for lunch, if we leave now.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Don't worry, everyone's really nice and pious.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: My fondue...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: You can get that anytime!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: We'll go into the city tonight. Come.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Wait up—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Promise me you'll walk slower, and I'll go with you!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: We finally reached the bottom of the mountain. Look this way, Elena.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I didn't come to have a snowball fight with you!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: What are you talking about? It's a Kjerag tradition to paint the forehead with snow and pray for Kjeragandr's protection.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I wouldn't describe what you just did as 'paint'.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Close enough. We don't really care for ceremony here in Kjerag.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You can't fool me! I'm sure all those books in the Hall of Writings—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Now let me get the right side of your forehead.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Joanna—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Haha!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Get back here!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Whoaaaaaaa—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Hold on tight, Elena, or you're gonna get thrown from the sled.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Is this why you prayed for Kjeragandr to protect the two of us? For this crazy ride through the forest on this run-down wooden sled—

steps.name: Rift Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Purrs)

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Two of us plus the Rift Cloudbeast!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: What are you calling 'run-down wooden sled'? So many people who want to ride the sleds of Kjerag don't get the chance!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Let's go even faster! It'll feel really good!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Whoaaa—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Whew—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Good to have a nice sunny day like this after the disaster. The Rift Cloudbeast looks much happier.

steps.name: Rift Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Purrs)

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: ...Elena? What's the matter? Keep up!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: How am I... supposed to... keep up... when you're... faster than a fowlbeast *cough* *cough*—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Tired too soon? But we climbed Mount Karlan together.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That's because... E-Enya stopped to wait for me from time to time! But you *cough* *cough*—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm supposed to be going out for lunch, not for a hike...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Well, you can sit a little while. I can wait.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: *pant* H-How long do we have to go...?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Almost there.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Over this hill, and then we're only half an hour from finding someone.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Whoa!
The Rift Cloudbeast climbs onto Elena's shoulder, like it did back on Mount Karlan.
It does not realize that it would be the last straw that 'breaks' the scientist.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Oh... R-Rift Cloudbeast—
Joanna and her pet look at each other in stunned silence at the sight of Elena lying motionless on the ground.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: L-Look what you've done!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: You killed a Rhine Lab researcher!

steps.name: Rift Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Purrs)

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Y-You're right! Elena isn't dead! We've made it through worse. She even saw Kjeragandr with her own eyes!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Elena? Are you alright? Please don't be dead!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: If you die—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: She's moving!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: *cough* *cough*—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: She's sweating all over and coughing up foam... her lips are blue too...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: What do I do, what do I do... are Columbians this weak? I've never seen this happen to someone from Kjerag...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: ...I-I'll find help right now!
Joanna crouches down and lifts Elena violently by her clothes. She slings Elena over her shoulders and locks Elena's arms and legs with her own.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Heave, ho—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Hang in there, Elena!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You might as well put me out of my misery with a bolt if you're gonna carry me like this...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I think I'm really going to die now...
She forces out her last words, and closes her eyes...
'Alright, Genne, I know you like to listen to Dad's stories about the stars, but it's time to go to bed.'
'You want to see the stars outdoors? You're too little right now, but when you grow up, we'll climb the highest mountains and see all the stars, okay?'
'No, we're not taking you for a ride. Someday, you'll go to bed with a smile on your face under the starry firmament.'
'After all, your name means 'origin of stars'...'

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: She's awake!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Where am I...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: A clinic in the mountains. This doctor saved your life.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Thank... you...

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: She's exaggerating. The concoction will only soothe your symptoms. You need to rest.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: What's she sick with, doctor?

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: Foreigners have a hard time with Kjerag's high mountains.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: While the symptoms may not be obvious in everyday life, Elena was clearly overexerted and exhausted when she was brought in, causing the symptoms to intensify.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: I'm so sorry, Elena! Come on, Rift Cloudbeast, let's apologize together!

steps.name: Rift Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Purrs)

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's alright, I know you didn't mean any harm.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Let me get up—
Elena stumbles as she tries to get out of bed. Joanna quickly moves to help her up.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: By Kjeragandr, just stay put!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm fine...

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: No need to worry. She'll get better soon.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...I'm glad there's a clinic up here. I thought the snowy mountains were gonna be the last thing I'd ever see.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: It's not easy for the hunters to go down the mountains, so they asked the Vine-Bead Court to send a doctor.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: I was studying medicine at the Hall of Writings, so Elder Adso sent me. That was more than a decade ago.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: Ever since Karlan Trade opened new hospitals in the cities, though, people have started to go there instead, even though it's further away, so things have gotten quieter here.
Doctor...

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: Oh, sorry, Mia. So busy I forgot about you.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: Did the new stomach medicine work better?

steps.name: Kjerag Woman
steps.text: No, doctor. My belly still hurts...

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: Hm, that's unusual. Did you get it checked in the city?

steps.name: Kjerag Woman
steps.text: I don't trust the city people... so many have taken their chemical stuff and gotten sick in other ways.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: Hm... well, take a seat, and I'll look through the books to see if there's something else that can be done.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Maybe I can help.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I have a sonograph with me. It can be used to perform basic scans on human organs.

steps.name: Kjerag Woman
steps.text: But that's city-folk stuff, isn't it?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Does it matter? It's not like you have anything to lose.

steps.name: Kjerag Woman
steps.text: Forget it... never seen anything like this before...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Come on, Elena, help me convince her—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Elena?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What I mean is, it's not city-folk stuff.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's an instrument that 'She' has blessed.
Her words surprise even herself. She was not supposed to subscribe to such mysticism.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: My, my...

steps.name: Kjerag Woman
steps.text: You mean... Kjeragandr?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I had the honor of traveling together with the Saintess for a while. This instrument allowed me to see Her true form.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You know, of course, that She does not reveal herself easily. It stands to reason that She must have permitted this instrument to perceive Her.
She winks at the huntress next to her.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: ...She's telling the truth.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: We're the Saintess's servants. We accompanied her when she sought an audience with Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Yes, yes, the Saintess...

steps.name: Kjerag Woman
steps.text: I do remember hearing people say that the Saintess was accompanied by two attendants when she came back, one of whom was a foreigner...

steps.name: Kjerag Woman
steps.text: Where did you see Her, then? What did She say to you?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: She said—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: (Whisper) What DID She say?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: 'Seek not my temple, but my heart.'

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: We are all ignorant children in Her presence... before the mysteries of this great land.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: True ignorance is to lack the courage to venture into the unknown beyond one's own beliefs.

steps.name: Kjerag Woman
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Kjerag Woman
steps.text: I-I'll trust you. What should I do?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Please take off your jacket. I'll get ready.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: Phew... thank you so much. Without you, I would never have realized that she had developed gallstones.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But... she refused to go to a hospital for treatment, even though she agreed to let me examine her.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: I'll talk to Mia again when she comes back for her medicine next time.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's not something that can be easily treated with pharmaceuticals alone. I wish I had tried harder to convince her...

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: ...Mia's a smart woman. She may not have necessarily believed what you said about the instrument being blessed, but she agreed to be examined. That was the furthest she could accept, right now.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: The smarter someone is, the more likely they'll be stubborn about their views. So their prejudices go way deeper than other people's.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: It's so hard to change one's prejudices, without seeing certain things for oneself.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Have you had a lot of experiences like this?

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: Yes. I didn't like the new things that Karlan Trade brought in at first, but I have to admit their usefulness when I see them in action, like today.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: It's the other way round now. Quite a few people seem to have a prejudice against me, thinking that the old stuff from the past is all myths and lies. Nothing I can do about it.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: Perhaps someday, they'll see the good in those old things, and realize their narrow-mindedness, haha.

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: Anyway, I should thank you on Mia's behalf. It's getting dark. How about you two stay for dinner?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Dinner? What do you have?

steps.name: Kjerag Doctor
steps.text: Mm... some vegetables, and two smoked sausages—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Wow! Did you hear that, Elena? We're in for a treat!
Elena takes a stroll outside the clinic after dinner. She can faintly hear Joanna and the doctor chatting around the dinner table.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The stars of Kjerag...

She rubs her hands together. The white vapors that come out as she exhales fade into the night in the wind. She walks forward slowly, toward the starry heavens that she can almost reach out and touch.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Good news! I finally got the doctor to agree to roast the last half of the sausage!

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Have a little bit later, and then you can take the rest back with you when I bring you back to the station.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Why aren't you saying anything, Elena? Are you feeling sick again?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Oh, no, I'm just thinking.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: About what? This sky? You've been looking up at it for a while.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Yeah... I've never seen the stars so clearly with the naked eye.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: I've looked up at them all my life. Didn't think they were anything special.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: My family, the Urbicas, has a long tradition of astrology.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I don't get along with my parents anymore, but they used to watch the stars with me, using telescopes.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But the stars were always so dim when I pulled open the curtains and looked out at the night sky outside the window. My parents couldn't explain why; they just told me that you can't see the stars as clearly in the cities as you can out in the wilderness, on the mountains.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The question planted itself in my heart like a seed. I was frustrated with my ignorance, at the lack of answers...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It was only when I grew up and read about light pollution and atmospheric turbulence in the library that I found the answer.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: ...I don't know much about the stars, but sometimes being ignorant isn't such a bad thing.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: If you didn't think you were ignorant, you wouldn't have gone to the library to find the answer.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Did your parents ever tell you why they liked to look at the stars? That 'astrology' thing?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's not a question of like or not. It's my family's tradition.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Hunting and sculpting are my family's tradition, but I don't think my ancestors would have carried it on for so long if they didn't like it...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...I remember now. My mother told me something that my ancestors once said.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: 'Beauty and the unknown.' Beauty makes people gaze into the unknown, and the unknown makes people feel a deeper beauty.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Maybe that's why they started stargazing...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Well... I'm not sure I understood it, but it sounded like the clerics reciting the Kjeragandr, so I guess that's not a bad thing.

spans.text: Well... I'm not sure I understood it, but it sounded like the clerics reciting the
, so I guess that's not a bad thing.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Anyway, it's time for us to go down. I'll go wrap up that sausage for you.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Thanks, Joanna.

steps.name: Local Researcher
steps.text: Had fun today, Elena? You were the last one to come back.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Well, it was a long day. It did end up being fun, I guess?

steps.name: Local Researcher
steps.text: The receptionist said there's a guest here looking for you. Said you hadn't been writing back, and they're not leaving until they see your face.

steps.name: Local Researcher
steps.text: They're in the reception room.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: A guest? For me?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'll go now.

steps.name: Local Researcher
steps.text: Hey, is that... smoked wild game sausage I smell?!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You like this? My guide friend said Kjerag locals like it more than fondue.

steps.name: Local Researcher
steps.text: Probably a tradition thing? I grew up in a poor family, and I would be overjoyed when we got smoked sausage. I prefer fondue now, though.

steps.name: Local Researcher
steps.text: So... could I have a bit of the sausage?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I see... I'm not hungry yet. I'll go see the guest; you can help yourself.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...I knew it.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Genne...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: So glad you're alright...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Sia...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I've been sending letters ever since the Catastrophe, trying to make sure that you're alright.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Then I heard that there was a skirmish between Kjerag and Victoria, and I got even more anxious...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Mm... there was a suspension of incoming mail that only recently got lifted.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Were you hurt? Sick? Is everything okay?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Well... a lot happened. Maybe I changed a little bit...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But I'm doing fine. Everything that's fine...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No need to worry.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Good to hear that...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I brought your favorite coffee beans from Columbia. The same kind that our favorite breakfast place in Trimounts uses.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: And a hand-grinder, too. It's a little late for coffee, but if you want—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Yes! I haven't had good coffee in a long while since I came to Kjerag.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Heh, give me a minute.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Did you come from Columbia? I thought you spend most of your time on Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: A lot's happened to Rhodes Island lately. We can talk about that later...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Anyway, I went home after the events at Rhodes Island. Mother fell sick around the same time that the Catastrophe hit Kjerag, so I stayed a few more days and took turns with father to care for her.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I tried to tell them about what you're doing in Kjerag, but it didn't take long for father's expression to grow dark. He told me through clenched teeth that he didn't want to hear your name.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I knew it.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: And then I found out that he had been buying a few different newspapers, and trying to keep it a secret from me.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I thought he didn't like to read the news.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Because Kjerag was all over the news those few days...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: He took the newspapers into mother's room, talking as he flipped through them... they hugged, and his eyes were red as he left the room.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Maybe he's just getting old... he and mother want to know more about you, Genne.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Sia, you know I... they...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I'm not here to lobby for them. You know I'm on your side, and I know what they did to you.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: But if one day, they ask me about you... can I tell them?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Is mother alright?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Just a bout of flu that hit harder than usual. She had recovered by the time I left.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: She wouldn't let herself show any weakness. She was back to her stone-faced self the first day her fever faded.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Hmph... good to hear, I guess.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Do you still carry your astrology notes with you, Sia?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Yeah. Why do you ask?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...I want to take a look.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I thought you didn't like astrology.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I... I saw the 'god' of the Kjerag when I was investigating the Kjerag Catastrophe.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: At first, I thought all this talk about 'god' was just a load of hot air, and I was frustrated that my companions believed in the existence of a 'god', even though the most rational explanation was an Originium vein.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Until I walked into the cave... and saw biosignals on my instruments.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: When the word 'Feranmut' came to my mind, I realized that my research wasn't so different from our family astrology, after all.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That irredeemable asshole, Mr. Urbica, father...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I started to understand him, just a little.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You don't need to reject the path you chose, Genne...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No, no, it's not that.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I revealed a glimpse of the truth, the secret behind the veil. I won't stop there.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I continue to believe that science is the best way to explore the unknown, and the path that I'm meant to walk.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Our ancestors may have gone down the wrong path, but it doesn't mean what they did was meaningless.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But... they never got the chance to see the stars in Kjerag. And so, it's our turn to continue this journey of exploration that goes on and on.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Do what you want to do, Genne. I'll have your back, always.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Why do you look so surprised? Am I not allowed here?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...The Director told me the local volunteer guide would only come along the first day.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: I'm just here to hang out with my friends from afar. No need to follow their rules.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: What do you say, Rift Cloudbeast?

steps.name: Rift Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Purrs)

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I guess you're right...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Alright, but I'm only coming with you if you agree to two things.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: You got it. What are they?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: First, we'll not run all over the mountains again!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Second... let's go down the mountain and have some fondue.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: I told you, that stuff's—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Nope, I want to try it for myself before judging whether it's good or not.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Alright, alright...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Let's go.
